simple.meaning: טָוָה (ṭâvâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to spin.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 35:25. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָוָה (H2901) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: טָוָה (ṭâvâh) / H2901 is traced through Exodus 35:25, Exodus 35:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2901. tavah [ טָוָה ] verb spin (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic מַטְוַוְיְתָא spider Job 8:14 ᵑ7 (but Syriac = roast, broil , see Dr JPh xi, 1882, 207 ); Assyrian ‰âmû (‰âuû) , spin , Hpt ZA, 1887, 274 Dl HWB 302 ; Arabic fold, wind ; Ethiopic : be twisted ) — Qal Perfect 3plural טָווּ work of women of Israel Exod 35:25 absolute, 35:26 followed by accusative אֶתהָֿעִזִּים goats , i.e. goats' hair (P).

occurrences.englishText: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
